title: coleus blumei var. telfordii
intro: Coleus blumei var. telfordii, commonly known as Coleus or Painted Nettle, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia and Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Coleus blumei var. telfordii include its ability to reduce fever, ease pain, and treat respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are primarily composed of flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, including rutin, kaempferol, and quercetin, which have been found to possess strong antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
